title: Common
description: Shared primitives for every platform contract. Money is always a decimal string; never a JSON number.

Ref.title: Ref
Ref.description: Opaque, pseudonymous identifier. Never contains personal data.

IntentId.title: IntentId
IntentId.description: Dotted intent or event id with at least two segments, e.g. 'finance.safe_to_spend'.

ActionKind.title: ActionKind
ActionKind.description: Kind of persistent action a capability may propose. Kinds that move money are forbidden on this platform: any segment equal to payment, transfer, purchase, credit or loan is rejected.

Locale.title: Locale
Locale.description: BCP 47 language tag, language + optional region: fi, fi-FI, sv-FI, en-FI.

DecimalString.title: DecimalString
DecimalString.description: Exact decimal with two fraction digits and '.' separator. Localised formatting happens only in the UI.

Epistemic.title: Epistemic
Epistemic.description: What kind of claim this is. fact = read from a record; calculated = deterministic from facts; estimate = deterministic but depends on assumptions or forecasts; educational = general content, not about the user's data; observed = perceived from a camera capture and may be misread.

LText.title: LText
LText.description: Localised text keyed by locale. At least one entry.

ConfirmChannel.title: ConfirmChannel
ConfirmChannel.description: How a user may confirm a proposal. voice_readback and glasses_gesture are allowed only for low-risk, reversible actions after the summary has been read back.

ConfirmationPolicyRules.title: ConfirmationPolicyRules
ConfirmationPolicyRules.$comment: Validation-only rules applied to any object with risk, reversible and confirm_channels. Stripped during code generation.

allOf.$comment: Hands-free confirmation (voice or gesture) only for low-risk, reversible actions.
High-risk actions require biometric confirmation on the phone and nothing else.

Confidence.title: Confidence
Confidence.description: Deterministic data-coverage confidence, not a model self-report.

MediaUri.title: MediaUri
MediaUri.description: Reference to the platform's ephemeral media store. Never a public URL.

DeviceCapability.title: DeviceCapability
DeviceCapability.description: Capabilities negotiated with the connected glasses at session start. Availability varies by device and SDK version.

GlassesInput.title: GlassesInput
GlassesInput.description: Normalised glasses input. The companion maps device-specific events (touchpad, capture button, Neural Band) onto these.
